notes:
Account snapshot / recent notes:
- Customer is a core logistics platform (real-time routing + driver chat). Heavy reliance on reranking for search + embeddings for docs/manifest lookup.
- Current setup: mixed hosted + small Dedicated pool (4xA100) provisioned late 2023. Contract ends 2025-06-30.
- Primary asks: predictable tail latency (50-150ms target for chat/rerank), scale to 200+ reqs/s peak, data residency in eu-west for EU customers, stronger audit trail for regulated manifests.
- Expansion asks: upgrade Dedicated pool to H100-backed instances for cost-per-token and latency gains; region expansion to eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1; add Redwood Optimize to tune batching + prefix caching to reduce per-token cost ~20-30%.
- Security: must have SSO/SAML + KMS integration; retention controls for PII (30/90 day variants); audit logs to match internal retention policy. Legal submitted DPA with 5 redlines, mostly around subprocessing and data residency.
- Finance: CFO wants ARR banding and fixed monthly committed spend vs burstable pricing. Looking for 12-24m committed Dedicated contract with optional burst credit.
- Quote from Head of Platform: "Need predictable tail — we can’t have routing stalls during morning peaks. Willing to commit if latency and residency guaranteed."
- Internal notes: SE Maya to run focused benchmark on their replay logs (sample set) against H100 vs A100 in eu-west. Infra to validate autoscale/burst plan. CSM Oliver to align on onboarding and eval metrics for Optimize pilot.
- Risk: If capacity for H100 in eu-west not available by May, customer will consider a multi-region fallback which complicates residency.
- Decision criteria: latency SLOs met, DPA terms acceptable, CFO signs off on committed spend.
- Action items: 1) Schedule infra deep-dive (by 2025-03-07). 2) Send revised pricing + DPA response (owner: Ethan). 3) Define Optimize pilot success metrics (reduce tokens by X%, maintain quality thresholds).
